lines.en: label sportswars12:
scene deathball1
: Whaaaaaaaat the fuck is that thing?
lines.zh: : 这他妈到底是什么鬼东西？

lines.en: : Large and in charge. Let’s bake this bread.
lines.zh: : 又大又威风。咱们这就开干。
: 这是……

lines.en: : It’s beautiful...
lines.zh: : 太美了……

lines.en: scene black
scene deathball2
scene deathball3
scene black
scene deathball4
scene black
scene deathball5
scene black
scene deathball6
: {i}Right here’s okay?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}放这儿行吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yeah. That’s the only chair we have.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}行。我们只有这一把椅子。{/i}

lines.en: scene deathball7
: Sorry...It’s just been a while since I’ve talked about this.
lines.zh: : 抱歉……只是我已经很久没谈起这件事了。

lines.en: : {i}Can you start by introducing yourself?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}能先做个自我介绍吗？{/i}

lines.en: scene deathball8
: Yumi Yamaguchi. Professor of psychology at Kumon-mi University.
lines.zh: : Yumi Yamaguchi。Kumon-mi 大学心理学教授。

lines.en: : {i}Can you tell us your version of what happened that day?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}能讲讲你对那天发生的事情的说法吗？{/i}

lines.en: : God...where do I even begin?
lines.zh: : 天哪……该从哪儿说起呢？

lines.en: scene deathball9
: Girls! I present to you — the death ball!
lines.zh: : 姑娘们！现在呈现在你们面前的——就是死亡球！

lines.en: : Can’t...breathe! So...heavy!
lines.zh: : 喘……喘不上气！好……好重！

lines.en: scene deathball10
: I would like to get off Mr. Bones’ Wild Ride now.
lines.zh: : 我现在想从“骨头先生的疯狂之旅”上下来了。

lines.en: : That...is a very large ball.
lines.zh: : 那……是个非常大的球。

lines.en: scene deathball11
: It was such a large ball!
lines.zh: : 那球可真大啊！

lines.en: : {i}Do you have an estimation on how large it was exactly?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你能估计一下它到底有多大吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Very!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}非常大！{/i}

lines.en: scene deathball10
: So, like...what do we do with it?
lines.zh: : 那……我们要拿它怎么办？

lines.en: : Excellent question, Yumi!
lines.zh: : 问得好，Yumi！

lines.en: scene deathball12
: Rika, what do we do with it?
lines.zh: : Rika，我们要拿它怎么办？

lines.en: : Me?!
: Yeah! You get to choose the rules of this game.
lines.zh: : 对啊！由你来定这场比赛的规则。

lines.en: : Why me?! I can’t be trusted with balls this big. Besides, you won’t even let me drive your car! It’s proof I can’t be trusted!
lines.zh: : 为什么是我？！这么大的球我可担不起这个责任。再说了，你连你的车都不让我开！这就是我不可信的证据！

lines.en: : For the last time, Rika- that was not my car. That was my neighbor’s car. And I cannot give you permission to use other people’s things.
lines.zh: : 我最后说一遍，Rika——那不是我的车。那是我邻居的车。而且我也不能允许你动别人的东西。

lines.en: scene deathball13
: We were all so foolish back then.
lines.zh: : 我们那时候都太傻了。

lines.en: : To think we could have just...put a stop to it, but...
lines.zh: : 想想看，我们本来可以……就此打住的，可是……

lines.en: : You know, when you’re that young, it’s hard to see five feet in front of you.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，人在那么年轻的时候，连眼前五英尺都看不清。

lines.en: : And it’s even harder when there’s a thirty foot ball right there blocking your line of sight.
lines.zh: : 更何况还有个三十英尺的球挡在眼前挡住视线，那就更难了。

lines.en: scene deathball14
: I would have let you drive {i}my{/i} neighbor’s car! I give so much and get so little!
lines.zh: : 换作是我，我就让你开{i}我{/i}邻居的车了！我付出那么多，得到的却这么少！

lines.en: : Isn’t this kind of dangerous? That thing looks like it could crush us.
lines.zh: : 这玩意儿是不是挺危险的？看着像能把我们压扁。

lines.en: : Only the weak are crushed. True champions rise above the challenge and grab life by its oversized balls.
lines.zh: : 只有弱者才会被压扁。真正的冠军会迎难而上，抓住生活那对超大号的蛋。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t care how strong you are, you are not grabbing life by {i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: : 行，不管你多强壮，生活{i}那玩意儿{/i}你也是抓不住的。

lines.en: : I want to climb it.
lines.zh: : 我想爬上去。

lines.en: scene deathball15
: {i}You seemed to enjoy death ball more than the rest of your classmates. Why was that?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你看起来比其他同学都更享受死亡球。这是为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : There was just something about it, you know? I’d never seen a ball that huge before. And the way I see it, the bigger the balls, the more fun I’m going to have when all is said and done.
lines.zh: : 它就是有那么一种感觉，你懂吧？我以前从来没见过那么大的球。而且在我看来，球越大，到最后我玩得就越开心。

lines.en: : {i}Cut. Can we get a retake there, Uta? I’ve had to warn some of the other girls, but this docuseries isn’t for mature audiences, so we can’t have you saying things like...what was it again?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}卡。Uta，这段能重录一遍吗？我已经提醒过其他几个女生了，这部纪录剧集不是给成年观众看的，所以不能让你说那种……那句是什么来着？{/i}

lines.en: scene deathball16
: ...The bigger the balls, the more fun I’m going to have when all is said and done?
lines.zh: : ……球越大，到最后我玩得就越开心？

lines.en: : {i}Yeah. Please don’t say things like that anymore.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}对。以后别再说这种话了。{/i}

lines.en: : I didn’t mean it like that, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : Like, I love death ball. Don’t get me wrong. But I’ve never had {i}that{/i} sort of relationship with it. I mean...the death ball wasn’t built for love. It was built to destroy.
lines.zh: : 就是说，我热爱死亡球。别误会。但我和它之间没有{i}那种{/i}关系。我是说……死亡球不是为爱而造的。它是为毁灭而造的。

lines.en: scene deathball7
: The death ball was built to destroy...
lines.zh: : 死亡球是为毁灭而造的……

lines.en: scene deathball17
: It was built to destroy.
lines.zh: : 它是为毁灭而造的。

lines.en: scene black
scene deathball18
scene deathball19
: How about this?! Since we can’t decide on the rules, we’ll let you girls figure everything out on your own.
lines.zh: : 这样如何？！既然我们定不下规则，那就让你们女生自己把一切搞定。

lines.en: : Imani, I’m not sure if I’m okay with my daughter handling balls this huge yet. She’s still in high school.
lines.zh: : Imani，我还不确定能不能接受我女儿去碰这么大的球。她还在上高中呢。

lines.en: : Don’t try to tell me what balls I can and can’t handle, Mom!
lines.zh: : 别来告诉我什么球我能碰什么球我不能碰，妈！

lines.en: : But also, yeah. I would like to go home now.
lines.zh: : 不过，话说回来，对。我现在想回家了。

lines.en: : Too bad! The contestants have already been locked in and our viewers are expecting a show! So either you leave your friends to die, or all of you die together!
lines.zh: : 太遗憾了！参赛选手已经被锁在场内，观众们都在等着看戏呢！所以要么你抛下朋友让她们去死，要么你们一起死！

lines.en: scene deathball20
: {i}Would you say you were prepared to die back then?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你会说你们当时已经做好赴死的准备了吗？{/i}

lines.en: : No! Absolutely not! None of us were!
lines.zh: : 没有！绝对没有！我们谁都没有！

lines.en: scene deathball21
: Well...except for Uta. I still don’t fully understand her relationship with the death ball.
lines.zh: : 嗯……除了 Uta。我到现在也没完全搞懂她和死亡球之间的关系。

lines.en: : {i}She assured us earlier that it was never romantic. But she acknowledged how it might have looked like that to all of you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她之前向我们保证那从来不是什么浪漫关系。但她也承认，在你们看来确实可能是那样。{/i}

lines.en: : Getting some reassurance after all these years is great. But there’s still so much about that day I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 过了这么多年能得到这样的澄清是好事。但那一天还有太多事我想不明白。

lines.en: : {i}Would you say it was the hardest thing you’ve ever had to endure?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你会说那是你经历过最艰难的事吗？{/i}

lines.en: : It was the hardest thing any {i}one{/i} of us had to endure. And anyone who tells you otherwise is lying.
lines.zh: : 那是我们当中任何{i}一个人{/i}都不得不经历的最艰难的事。谁要是告诉你别的，那都是在撒谎。

lines.en: scene deathball22
: It wasn’t that bad.
lines.zh: : 其实也没那么糟。

lines.en: scene deathball23
: You know, I think the craziest part of that whole ordeal was just how...unorganized it was. None of us had any idea what we were doing.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我觉得整场磨难里最离谱的一点就是它有多么……毫无组织。我们谁都不知道自己在干什么。

lines.en: : {i}Can you elaborate on that a little more, please?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}能请你再详细说说吗？{/i}

lines.en: scene deathball24
: I work with kids a lot nowadays. And there are things you just...{i}can’t{/i} do with them.
lines.zh: : 我现在经常和孩子们打交道。有些事你是……{i}不能{/i}对他们做的。

lines.en: : For example, rolling out a thirty foot ball and telling them to just “go” would land you in hot water nowadays.
lines.zh: : 比如说，推出一个三十英尺的球然后叫他们“上”，放现在早就让你吃不了兜着走了。

lines.en: : But back then...everyone got away with {i}everything.{/i} And if we had any amount of direction at all...maybe things wouldn’t have ended up the way they did.
lines.zh: : 可那时候……所有人{i}怎么胡来{/i}都没人管。哪怕当初有哪怕一丁点指引……也许事情就不会变成那样了。

lines.en: : {i}At least you can be thankful you all managed to make it out alive.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}至少你们该庆幸自己都活着出来了。{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah...we’re all {i}alive.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊……我们都还{i}活着{/i}。

lines.en: scene deathball25
: But I think all of us would still tell you that some {i}part{/i} of us died that day...
lines.zh: : 但我想我们每个人都会告诉你，那一天，我们的{i}某一部分{/i}已经死了……

lines.en: scene deathball22
: It really wasn’t that bad.
lines.zh: : 真的没那么糟。

lines.en: scene deathball26
{i}Except it was...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}只是，它确实很糟……{/i}

lines.en: {i}That day would live on in infamy after what was meant to be a fun-filled event turned into something much more sinister.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那一天，本该充满欢乐的活动演变成了某种阴暗得多的东西，从此遗臭万年。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The property damages alone would come out to be over 3,000,000,000 yen. And, combined with the death toll, it quickly became the most devastating event in Kumon-mi since the volcano eruption of 1912.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}光是财产损失就超过 30 亿日元。再加上死亡人数，它迅速成为自 1912 年火山喷发以来 Kumon-mi 最惨重的事件。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But, if it was so deadly, why isn’t it talked about today?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}可既然它这么致命，为什么今天没人提起它呢？{/i}

lines.en: scene black
scene deathball27
scene black
scene deathball7
: {i}Can you tell us a little more about what your strategy was once the game began?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}能再多讲讲比赛开始后你们的策略是什么吗？{/i}

lines.en: scene deathball28
: At first, we thought it would be a good idea to try and gain control of the ball.
lines.zh: : 一开始，我们觉得试着控制住那个球是个好主意。

lines.en: : But it wasn’t until we realized that the ball had a mind of its own that we had to figure something else out.
lines.zh: : 可直到我们意识到那个球有自己的意志，我们才不得不想别的办法。

lines.en: : {i}It had a mind of its own?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}它有自己的意志？{/i}

lines.en: : That’s what I’ve always believed, at least. I can’t think of any other explanation as to why nothing we did worked.
lines.zh: : 至少我一直这么认为。我想不出别的解释，能说明为什么我们做什么都没用。

lines.en: : We were like cornered animals out there...like {i}prey.{/i} It could smell our fear. And it did everything in its power to take advantage of that.
lines.zh: : 我们在场上就像被逼到绝路的动物……像{i}猎物{/i}。它能嗅到我们的恐惧。而且它竭尽所能地利用了这一点。

lines.en: : {i}If you could go back to that day and change one thing about your strategy, what would it be?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果让你回到那天，改变策略中的一件事，你会改什么？{/i}

lines.en: : I would {i}never{/i} go back to that day. Not even hypothetically.
lines.zh: : 我{i}绝不{/i}会回到那一天。哪怕只是假设也不会。

lines.en: scene deathball29
: I keep trying to put a reunion game together, but the only one who’s agreed to it is Tsunecchi. And it’s not like any of the girls who {i}didn’t{/i} play would ever agree. Not after what they saw.
lines.zh: : 我一直想办一场重聚赛，可唯一答应下来的只有 Tsunecchi。而那些{i}没上场{/i}的女生，是绝对不可能同意的。在她们目睹了那些之后就不会。

lines.en: : {i}How do you think it looked from an outsider’s point of view?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你觉得从一个局外人的视角看，那是什么样的？{/i}

lines.en: : It’s hard to say. But personally, I think everybody’s being a little over-dramatic.
lines.zh: : 很难说。不过就我个人而言，我觉得大家都反应过度了点。

lines.en: scene deathball30
: RUN FOR YOUR LIVES! WE’RE ALL GOING TO DIE!
lines.zh: : 快逃命啊！我们全都要死了！

lines.en: : Bow before me, mortals! I am Rin, queen of the death ball! And I am here to claim your lives!
lines.zh: : 凡人们，在我面前跪下吧！我是 Rin，死亡球女王！我是来收你们命的！

lines.en: : How did you even get up there?! Weren’t you being crushed by it a second ago?!
lines.zh: : 你到底是怎么上去的？！你不是一秒前还被它压着吗？！

lines.en: : Yumi freed me! We’re in love and you should be jealous!
lines.zh: : 是 Yumi 把我救出来的！我们相爱了，你该嫉妒才对！

lines.en: : No we’re not and no she shouldn’t! I’m just trying to win the fuckin’ game!
lines.zh: : 我们没有，她也不该！我只是想把这该死的比赛赢下来！

lines.en: : Green Onion, Succubus! Stand aside! I will cut down the death ball and obtain its core to use as an ingredient in soup!
lines.zh: : 葱妖，魅魔！让开！我要把死亡球斩于马下，取它的核心来做汤的食材！

lines.en: : HOW AM I SUPPOSED TO STAND ASIDE WHEN I DON’T EVEN KNOW WHAT DIRECTION I’M GOING IN?!
lines.zh: : 我连自己朝哪个方向走都不知道，你要我怎么让开？！

lines.en: : Imani! What have you done now?! The entire field is on fire!
lines.zh: : Imani！你这次又干了什么？！整个场地都烧起来了！

lines.en: : It was Rika! All of this was her idea! I told her she was going too far but she wouldn’t listen!
lines.zh: : 是 Rika！这一切都是她的主意！我跟她说她做得太过了，可她就是不听！

lines.en: : Stop throwing me under the death ball! I mean death bus! I mean bus! This is one of the very few occasions where I am completely innocent!
lines.zh: : 别再把我往死亡球底下推了！我是说死亡巴士！我是说巴士！这可是我为数不多完全无辜的场合之一！

lines.en: : Nuh-uh! You touched it last!
lines.zh: : 才怪！你最后碰的它！

lines.en: : Aaaah fuck! I did, didn’t I?!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊操！我确实碰了，是吧？！

lines.en: : Rin! Your not-mom is coming to save you from the giant ball and the fire and stuff! But not because she loves you or anything! You just happen to be the first of six girls who-
lines.zh: : Rin！你的“不是妈妈”来把你从那个巨型球和大火之类的东西里救出来了！但这可不是因为她爱你什么的！你只不过是六个女生里第一个——

lines.en: : Sorry, can’t hear you! Don’t know you! Killing all of my friends!
lines.zh: : 抱歉，听不见！不认识你！我要杀光我所有的朋友！

lines.en: : Not if I kill them first! Denizens of floor two, fall back!
lines.zh: : 那得看谁先杀了她们！二层居民，撤退！

lines.en: scene deathball31
: {i}If you had to choose one girl who contributed the most to ending that chaotic first game of death ball, who would it be?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果必须选出一位对终结那场混乱的首届死亡球贡献最大的女生，会是谁？{/i}

lines.en: : Oh, Tsuneyo. It’s not even close.
lines.zh: : 哦，Tsuneyo。毫无悬念。

lines.en: scene deathball32
: It would have to be Tsuneyo, right? She’s the only one who made any difference at all. The rest of us were only there as sacrifices.
lines.zh: : 肯定得是 Tsuneyo 吧？她是唯一真正起了作用的人。我们其余的人在那儿只是当祭品的。

lines.en: scene deathball33
: Every single one of us owes our life to her.
lines.zh: : 我们每一个人都欠她一条命。

lines.en: : Like, I don’t even want to think about what would have happened if a different class played this game.
lines.zh: : 说真的，要是换个班来玩这场比赛会发生什么，我连想都不愿意想。

lines.en: : {i}What was it that made Tsuneyo’s contribution to the game so special exactly?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}究竟是什么让 Tsuneyo 在这场比赛中贡献如此特别？{/i}

lines.en: scene deathball34
: {i}Probably the part where she picked the ball up and threw it into space.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}大概就是把球举起来扔进太空那一段吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Space?{/i}
: {i}Well, maybe not space. But definitely into the sky.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，也许不是太空。但肯定是扔到天上去了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Some say it’s still up there today.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有人说它到今天还在上面。{/i}

lines.en: scene deathball35
: I’m just a normal girl with normal hobbies.
lines.zh: : 我只是个有普通爱好的普通女孩。

lines.en: : {i}A great deal of the footage from that event has been scrubbed from existence, but we were able to recover a photo of you holding the death ball over your head just seconds before you threw it into space.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那次事件的影像绝大多数都已被抹除，但我们还是找回了一张照片——就在你把死亡球扔进太空的几秒前，你正把它举过头顶。{/i}

lines.en: : No, I will not sign an autograph for you.
lines.zh: : 不，我不会给你签名的。

lines.en: : {i}That’s fine. What I was going to say is that we had a team of researchers estimate the weight of the ball based on that photograph, and their estimation came out to be nearly 2,000lbs.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没关系。我想说的是，我们请了一组研究人员根据那张照片估算了球的重量，他们的估算结果是接近 2000 磅。{/i}

lines.en: : That is nothing. I could have lifted two if I was born with larger arms.
lines.zh: : 那算什么。要是我天生胳膊再粗点，我一次能举两个。

lines.en: : {i}I guess the question now is...where do you draw all of that strength from? And why did you wait so long to get rid of the ball?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那么现在的问题大概是……你这些力气是从哪儿来的？还有，你为什么等了那么久才把球弄走？{/i}

lines.en: : That is two questions.
lines.zh: : 这是两个问题。

lines.en: : {i}You can answer them in order.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你可以按顺序回答。{/i}

lines.en: scene deathball36
: I suppose my strength would have to come from my husband.
lines.zh: : 我想我的力气应该是来自我丈夫。

lines.en: : {i}Your husband?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你丈夫？{/i}

lines.en: scene deathball37
: He’s a wonderful man who treats me very well. And I could not imagine a life without him.
lines.zh: : 他是个很好的男人，对我非常好。我无法想象没有他的生活。

lines.en: : {i}But you weren’t married when you played that game of death ball. Where did your strength come from then?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可你打那场死亡球的时候还没结婚啊。那你的力气是从哪儿来的？{/i}

lines.en: : Who says we were not already married?
lines.zh: : 谁说我们那时候还没结婚？

lines.en: scene deathball38

lines.en: : But, in regard to why I did not get rid of the ball earlier...
lines.zh: : 不过，至于我为什么没有早点把球弄走……

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。
